With 4 spacious bedrooms and an additional versatile room perfect for a home office or guest room, this home has all the space you need. The home also boasts updated hardwood flooring throughout, two fully renovated bathrooms, and a freshly built deck that overlooks a lovely backyard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Conveniently located close to downtown Stamford, public transportation, and major highways, this home combines style and accessibility.  Don't miss the opportunity to live in this move-in-ready home!
